blurb: In celebration of the 50th anniversary of One Flew Over the Cuckoo’s Nest, filmed at the Oregon State Hospital, the Oregon State Hospital Museum of Mental Health is proud to announce Knit for Mental Fitness, a year-long community initiative supporting mental fitness awareness and benefiting both the Museum and Project ABLE.
